repo_notes.content: Three distinct engines share one repo: template generation, AST rewriting and AI refactoring. Keep them on separate pages; they fail in different ways.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: examples/ is unusually complete and is the fastest way to understand each engine.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: Toolkit Overview
pages.purpose: The three generation strategies this toolkit offers, when each is the right one, and how they are invoked from the CLI or as a library.

pages.title: Generators
pages.purpose: The generator implementations under src/generators/: the generator interface, scaffolding a project, and writing a custom generator.

pages.title: Templates
pages.purpose: The template engine under src/templates/: syntax, composition, and the variables a template may reference.

pages.title: AST Manipulation
pages.purpose: The AST layer under src/ast/: parsing, the transformation API, and how a rewrite is applied safely to existing source.

pages.title: AI-assisted Refactoring
pages.purpose: The AI path under src/ai/: prompt construction, what is sent, how a proposed change is validated before it is written, and the human review point.

pages.title: Examples
pages.purpose: The worked examples — CRUD generation, React scaffolding, AST refactoring, template composition, custom generators and AI refactor — and what each demonstrates.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The Vitest suite under tests/unit and how generated output is asserted.
